read.en: Meta fell 1.6% on Oct 27 to $620.19, trading between $619.22 and $628.46 on 2.6 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($648.0), 10-day ($682.3) and 30-day ($712.5), the rising 100-day ($630.8) and the falling 200-day ($632.3). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($723.08), and RSI is 32.
read.zh: Meta 10月27日下跌 1.6%，收于 $620.19，盘中区间 $619.22–628.46，成交量为平均水平的 2.6 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$648.0）、10 日（$682.3）和 30 日均线（$712.5）、上行的 100 日均线（$630.8）以及下行的 200 日均线（$632.3）下方。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$723.08），RSI 为 32。

read.en: The close broke $627.8 (Oct 26 low), now resistance. Resistance is $627.8–632.3 (Oct 26 low, 100 and 200-day), then $639.7 (Oct 22 low) and $648 (5-day, Oct 23 and 26 highs). Support is $612.4 (Aug 11 high), then $600 (Jan 20 low) and $577.1 (Jul 9 low). A close below $612.4 would open $600; above $632.3, $640–648.
